name: SendHQ
summary: Email API for developers with transactional and marketing plans, verified-domain sending, inbound email, delivery events and hosted templates.
best_for: developers and small product teams that want a simple email API with fixed monthly plans and no overage billing, and that keep bounce and complaint rates low
skip_if: you need a free tier, pay-as-you-go overage instead of a hard cap, or a high-volume plan above 200,000 emails a month
honest_knock: There is no free plan, only a 100-delivery trial to your own address. The monthly allowance is a hard cap: further sends are rejected, not billed. Sending is limited per sender address and paused automatically at the published bounce and complaint rates, and a pause stops sending for the whole workspace until support reviews it.

pricing.entry_price_terms: Starter Transactional · Starter Transactional billed monthly, 50,000 emails a month and 25 verified domains
pricing.notes: (read 2026-11-06 on sendhq.cc/pricing) SendHQ sells an email API in two plans, each for transactional or for marketing email. Starter costs $9 a month for transactional email or $19 a month for marketing email and includes 50,000 emails a month and 25 verified domains. Scale costs $39 a month for either type and includes 200,000 emails a month and 100 verified domains, plus priority support. Annual billing is 10% off twelve monthly payments: $97.20 a year for Starter Transactional, $205.20 for Starter Marketing and $421.20 for Scale. Every To, Cc and Bcc address counts as one email, and there are no automatic overage charges: once the monthly allowance is used, further sends are rejected until the next month or until you move to a larger plan. There is no free plan; new workspaces get a trial of 100 deliveries to your own account email or a test address. Plans are billed in USD, and stablecoins (USDC) are accepted on every plan.
